column1: # record-pairs.tsv — the commit pairs seed-corpus-from-record.sh builds the record fixtures from (cycle-129 FR-2, DEC-0154).
# base = the parent of the sprint's first implementation commit; head = the tree the round-1 review read (the last
# implementation commit before the first review-round fix); fix = the last commit that closed that sprint's feedback
# (review, audit and, for sprint-254, the Bridgebuilder round). feedback = the record-branch files under
# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-<N>/ the labels are seeded from (round-1 review, the audit, the Bridgebuilder triage);
# later review rounds are left out because they read a tree after head. Each pair is an [ASSUMPTION fact] in the
# sprint-255 implementation report.
# cycle-132 (Task 1.1, FR-1, SDD D-1.1) adds sprints 255 … 264 under the same convention, derived from
# `git log --reverse <main merge>^1..<main merge>^2` of each cycle's PR (#1282 9e53d5d2, #1283 dfc47772,
# #1286 7b024f5c) and the round-1 review / audit headers on the record branch, which name the commit each read:
# - 255–257 (origin/record/cycle-129-a2a): one implementation commit each (ee1625a0, 40df53ed, 163656ff);
#   255 seeded pr-11 … pr-18 itself, so its row drops evals/fixtures/review-prs/* (fixture copies and hidden keys);
#   fix = the last audit-round fix (b6802e4f, 9c4ed319); 257 also carries the PR #1282 Bridgebuilder round
#   (bb-triage.md, fix 2fb03b5c, which includes the CI fix 8e996514 to hop-locality.py), as 254 did.
# - 258–260 (origin/record/cycle-130-a2a): 258 drops evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/runs/* (341 run
#   directories regen.sh generates); 259's round-1 review read two commits (a293df09 + 6be23186);
#   260's read 4c279606 (c02d12bb + the calibration commits, per engineer-feedback-r1.md); fix = the last
#   audit-round fix (ffe162ef, 05830914, 53600ea3).
# - 261/262 share the base 4434d450 and interleave (262's 0fda13a0/c031144f/044ce03d precede 261's review
#   head 4af3294b). The `paths` column splits them on disjoint files: 262 is its row writer and report
#   (unchanged between 4af3294b and its review head 82c5cd7d), based at 0fda13a0^; 261 is everything else
#   minus README.md (463fbda1, a version sync of neither sprint). Each head..fix touches only its own files.
# - 263/264 (origin/record/cycle-131-honest-measurement): feedback under a2a/sprint-1/ and sprint-2/ (the
#   local labels), passed as record-root paths; 263 drops evals/fixtures/review-prs/* (other fixtures'
#   manifests and SHA256SUMS: hidden keys) and evals/tests/fixtures/c131-oracle/* (arm transcripts on pr-17/18).
# - 265 is not seeded: its change (reads-c131.py, reports) lives under grimoires/, which the seeder scopes out,
#   so base..head (ba3937ca^..ba3937ca) has no in-scope file. The PR #1283 / #1286 Bridgebuilder rounds
#   (76ba937e, aac80f4c) have no triage file on a record branch and are left out of every fix.
# `paths` (optional; `-` none): seed-corpus-from-record.sh --paths globs, `!` excludes.
